metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a complete Node.js LAS 1.4 inspect/render program at:

- [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js)

It supports:

- `node main.js --input <path> --output <path>`
- `inspect`: base64 LAS 1.4 -> structured dataset JSON
- `render`: dataset JSON -> base64 LAS 1.4

Key behaviors included:

- Strict LAS 1.4 public header parsing/serialization
- VLR and EVLR parsing/serialization
- Supported record kinds you listed (`LASF_Spec`, `LASF_Projection`, waveform, extra bytes, superseded, opaque)
- Point formats 0 through 10, including waveform fields and optional `extra_bytes_b64`
- Recompute derived header fields during render (instead of trusting provided values)
- Validation errors reported as `invalid_document` (inspect) or `invalid_request` (render input issues)
- Waveform packet payload bytes treated as opaque and round-tripped
- Uses only Node.js standard library, no dependencies/package files

I also ran a smoke test locally: render of your sample-style dataset followed by inspect of produced LAS; both returned `status: "ok"`.
